diff --git a/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py b/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
index 0833435..5d1b336 100644
--- a/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
+++ b/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
@@ -5,6 +5,60 @@ from unicodedata import normalize
 import openlibrary.catalog.merge.normalize as merge
 
 
+re_amazon_title_paren = re.compile(r'^(.*) \([^)]+?\)$')
+
+
+def build_titles(title: str) -> dict:
+    """Expand a full edition title into normalized title variants."""
+    normalized_title = merge.normalize(title).lower()
+    titles = [title, normalized_title]
+    if ' & ' in title:
+        alternate = title.replace(' & ', ' and ')
+        titles.extend([alternate, merge.normalize(alternate)])
+
+    for value in list(titles):
+        if value.lower().startswith('the '):
+            titles.append(value[4:])
+        elif value.lower().startswith('a '):
+            titles.append(value[2:])
+
+    if re_amazon_title_paren.match(title):
+        for value in list(titles):
+            match = re_amazon_title_paren.match(value)
+            if match:
+                titles.extend([match.group(1), merge.normalize(match.group(1))])
+
+    # Preserve order while removing duplicates from generated alternatives.
+    titles = list(dict.fromkeys(titles))
+    return {
+        'full_title': title,
+        'normalized_title': normalized_title,
+        'titles': titles,
+        'short_title': normalized_title[:25],
+    }
+
+
+def expand_record(rec: dict) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Build a normalized edition record suitable for matching."""
+    expanded = build_titles(rec['full_title'])
+    expanded['isbn'] = []
+    for field in ('isbn', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13'):
+        expanded['isbn'].extend(rec.get(field, []))
+
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+        'publish_country',
+    ):
+        if field in rec and rec[field] not in ('   ', '|||'):
+            expanded[field] = rec[field]
+    return expanded
+
+
 def cmp(x, y):
     return (x > y) - (x < y)
